title_en: Fall 2026 (80th Late-Term) Degree Conferment Ceremony and Department Graduation Event
summary: Graduating students of the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering (전기정보공학부) are asked to attend the 80th Late-Term Degree Conferment Ceremony on Friday, 28 August 2026 at 10:30 in the Gymnasium, Building 71, Gwanak Campus, and the department graduation event the same day from 13:00 to 14:00 in Building 301, Room 118. Students attending the department event must wear an academic gown and be seated in their assigned seat by 12:50. Gowns may be rented from 13 to 31 August 2026 at Building 39, and diplomas are collected after the department event or afterwards at the department office (Building 301, Room 319).
applies_to: The relevant graduating students (해당 졸업생) of the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering (전기정보공학부) graduating at the 80th Late-Term Degree Conferment Ceremony. The notice asks them to attend; it does not state that attendance is mandatory.

steps: Rent an academic gown between 13 and 31 August 2026 (rentals end before 31 August) at the gown storage room next to the security office, 1st floor, Building 39; follow the detailed rental notice to be announced later.

If you must collect your diploma before the ceremony, contact the department office (undergraduate and graduate contact numbers are in the original notice); early collection is possible from 27 August.
On 28 August 2026, attend the Degree Conferment Ceremony at 10:30 in the Gymnasium, Building 71, Gwanak Campus (it is also streamed live on the official YouTube channel).
Wearing your gown, be seated in your assigned seat in Building 301, Room 118 by 12:50 for the department graduation event (13:00–14:00).
Collect your diploma after the department event ends; if you did not attend, collect it afterwards at the department office (Building 301, Room 319).
If a proxy collects your diploma, give them the completed diploma collection power of attorney form (학위기 수령 위임장, attached to the original notice) and have them bring their own ID card.
Return your gown to the gown storage room in Building 39 by Monday, 31 August 2026.
translation:
80th Late-Term Degree Conferment Ceremony and Department Graduation Event

The degree conferment ceremony and graduation event are announced as follows. The relevant graduating students are asked to attend.

1. 80th Late-Term Degree Conferment Ceremony
(1) Date and time: Friday, 28 August 2026, 10:30 (streamed live on the official YouTube channel)
* The ceremony will be broadcast live on YouTube. Attendees may partly appear in the video, and the footage may be used as content for Seoul National University's official media.
(2) Venue: Gymnasium, Building 71, Gwanak Campus

2. Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering (전기정보공학부) Graduation Event
(1) Date and time: Friday, 28 August 2026, 13:00–14:00
(2) Venue: Building 301, Room 118
* Wear your academic gown and be seated in your assigned seat by 12:50.

3. College of Engineering and Department Photo Zones
(1) College of Engineering photo zone: Thursday, 13 August 2026 to Friday, 28 August 2026
- Open space on basement level 1 (B1) of Building 39, and the 2nd-floor entrance of Building 301
(2) Department photo zone: Friday, 14 August 2026 to Friday, 28 August 2026
- Lobby in front of the department office, Building 301, Room 319

4. Academic Gown Rental: Thursday, 13 August 2026 to Monday, 31 August 2026
- Gown storage room next to the security office, 1st floor, Building 39
* No rentals on Monday, 31 August (returns only).
* Detailed gown rental instructions will be announced later.

5. Collecting Your Diploma (학위기)
(1) Diplomas may be collected after the department graduation event ends. Students who do not attend the graduation event may collect their diploma at the department office after the event.
(2) A proxy may collect the diploma; the proxy must bring the attached diploma collection power of attorney form (학위기 수령 위임장) and the proxy's own ID card.
(3) Students who, for personal reasons, need to collect their diploma before the degree conferment ceremony (possible from 27 August) should contact the department office.
* Undergraduate and graduate office contact numbers are given in the original notice.
